title: the skeptic's verdict
description: role-settings.yaml's skeptic.output (json_schema), mapped onto Codex's --output-schema. Demanding a structured return makes an omission mechanically visible even where the report is cut off mid-work (the same aim as org_cycle intake, met on the return side). Structured Outputs requires every key in properties to appear in required (optional fields allow null).

verdict.description: The result of refuting against the MUSTs. A defect outside their scope does not count toward the verdict

why.description: The concrete scenario constructed and what happened when it was pushed. Even on survives, write for whom and under what condition it could break

evidence.description: What was actually run or read. The commands and their real output

mutations.description: The mutations whose post-application state could be measured. A failed application is left in evidence/risk as unmeasured

detected.description: Whether an existing test detected it

applied.description: Whether the post-mutation state was read back and the intended change confirmed to have actually taken. An attempt that is false is not included in mutations but left in evidence/risk as unmeasured

postcondition.description: The read command and real output of the post-application state, showing the mutation took

restore_postcondition.description: The read command and real output showing the original state was restored

out_of_scope.description: A defect found outside the MUSTs' scope. It does not count toward the verdict; return it as "recommended as its own Issue". An empty array where there is none

risk.description: A failure mode that could not be ruled out. Where there is none, say so explicitly

findings.description: Each finding, separately. The id is what a response and the next round point at, so a finding that is not listed here cannot be answered or tracked — put every blocking observation in, not a prose summary of them.

id.description: Stable within this Issue, e.g. GATE-001. A response cites it.

claim.description: What is wrong, specifically enough to be checked by someone else.

evidence.description: The command and output, or the file and line, that establishes it.

blocks_admission.description: Whether this alone withholds the verdict. False means it was worth saying but is not why the work is held.

prior_finding.description: The id of the earlier finding this re-raises, or null if new. Re-raising one unchanged does not warrant another round — state what changed.
